predecessors.name: Republic of Cyprus
predecessors.text: the northern four-elevenths of the island (about 36% of Cyprus's total area) taken by Turkish forces in 1974

ledger.x: 1974: the Turkish invasion leaves the north under a Turkish Cypriot administration.
1975: the Turkish Federated State of Cyprus is declared on 13 February.

13 February 1975: 'Turkey declared the occupied areas of the Republic of Cyprus to be a "Federated Turkish State"' (reopened 2026-11-01); the same page says of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus 'Turkey is the only country that recognises it'.
1983: the north declares itself the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus on 15 November.

wars.name: Turkish invasion of Cyprus
wars.outcome: Turkey took about 3% of the island in the first phase (20-22 July 1974) and 'approximately 36%' after the second (from 14 August); the August 1974 ceasefire line became the UN Buffer Zone, with the north under the Turkish Cypriot administration that became…

certainty.note: A de facto ceasefire line (August 1974) now the UN Buffer Zone, not a treaty frontier: the Republic of Cyprus and the UN treat the whole island as Cypriot territory.
